source_only_checks_without_mutation_expe.result: Recompute precedes exact-byte comparison; saved pose/report are not used as candidate solve inputs. No edited-output counterexample executed.
Pose embeds19 source hashes; report adds recomputed pose hash as20th. Report is not its own hash input. Fresh source hashing is consistency evidence, not independent historical source authorization.

source_only_checks_without_mutation_expe.topic: Original hierarchy, full mesh winding/depth and actual edge/triangle crossings
source_only_checks_without_mutation_expe.result: Component boxes prune only; whole-original-mesh tris determine winding/depth. Crossings use real native edges and Ray.intersectTriangle, followed by shared-interior tests. Candidate native checks executed through the original CLI; independent all-pair collision search not executed.

explicit_limitations: No browser, renderer, Blender, server, installation, reindex, production edit, Git/auth/global settings change or warehouse mutation.
Native collision probes are bounded; absence of detected witnesses is not full intersection or continuous-collision clearance.
No force/friction stability, strength, ergonomics or manual-handling certification.
Pickup, source approach/withdrawal, loaded walking/turning, same-HU setdown, packing and Scene integration remain unimplemented.
Candidate correctness and audit completion are distinct; root retains visual review and acceptance authority.
No coordinated source-and-output tampering experiment or adversarial installed-dependency substitution performed.
Declared source pin set is not asserted to cover every transitive execution dependency.
